$comment: The post-answer stage WIRE CONTRACT, as fixtures. Authority: docs/architecture/post-answer-stages.md §4.
Read by BOTH halves (§9): the Python frame-builder test asserts build_stage_frame() produces `delivered`,
and the TypeScript NATStageMessageSchema test asserts it parses them. The fixture is the contract; if the
two halves drift, one of them fails. `timestamp` is stamped at send time, so a producer test compares every
field EXCEPT that one.
`rejected` is the client half only — frames a producer must never emit and a client must therefore drop.
There is nothing for the frame builder to assert about them.
Additive only: a new stage adds a `delivered` entry and a payload shape. The envelope never changes; `v` is
bumped only on a breaking change to it.
`memory_reflection.ready.payload.proposals` (ADR-0055) are memory_proposal CARDS for which NOTHING was
written: an organization-scoped finding the BFF refused because the acting user does not hold
org:memory:write, offered for a person to accept. It is optional — absent, never [], when there are none —
and it is a separate key from `items` on purpose: a client that rendered a proposal as a written row would
claim a firm-wide note that does not exist.
`memory_reflection.ready.payload.items[].supersedes` (ADR-0055) is the note that item RETIRED — the id and
the retired note's own words, reported by the write path and capped like every other string here. It is
what makes a correction a STATED event: the transcript renders both halves and offers the undo, instead of
the replaced note silently vanishing from the memory panel. Present ONLY on an item that actually retired
one, which is why the first fixture item omits it and the second carries it — absent, never null, and
never a member of `items`, because it names a RETIRED row and `items` are the rows this turn wrote.

items.question: Wie wird das Fluchtniveau genau gemessen?

items.content: Das Projekt liegt in Wien; für Fluchtwege gilt die Wiener Bauordnung ergänzend zur OIB-Richtlinie 2.
Das oberste Fluchtniveau des Bauvorhabens beträgt 9,80 m, das Gebäude liegt damit in Gebäudeklasse 4.

supersedes.content: Das oberste Fluchtniveau beträgt 6,50 m, das Gebäude liegt damit in Gebäudeklasse 3.

proposals.title: Neue Erkenntnis merken
proposals.content: Das Büro legt Fluchtwegpläne grundsätzlich im Maßstab 1:100 an.

unknown-stage.why: A client that does not know a `stage` value drops the frame — which is exactly what an old tab should do.

unknown-status.why: Only ready/empty/failed reach the wire; `timeout` is mapped to `failed` and the rest never leave the runner.

wrong-version.why: `v` is the contract version. A frame from a future envelope is dropped rather than half-read.

payload-on-a-non-ready-frame.why: `payload` is absent unless status is `ready`. A payload beside `empty` means the two halves disagree about what happened, and rendering it would show chips for a turn the stage declined.
